summary.short_summary: The meeting addressed the stalled TSG acquisition effort, highlighting that only Altavia remains interested, preferring a partnership over acquisition. Five other buyers withdrew due to concerns about deal size and business model fit, leading to the need for an additional 6 to 18 months of SaaS track record before resale. The team decided to prioritize four core deals with higher closure potential, while also acknowledging marketing challenges that hinder seller sign-ups. Significant issues with email campaign infrastructure were reported, prompting a shift to improve outreach. Persistent seller resistance to reasonable deal terms was discussed, necessitating better seller education. The team emphasized the importance of workflow improvements and the integration of AI tools to enhance lead management and efficiency.
